title: Annotatio V §.V Hannekenius: No sound mystical-Body union when Truth is wounded — Charity the bond from Truth
pass_a_gloss: There cannot be a sound Union of the mystical Body and its members when Truth is wounded: for at once the Bond of Union is violated — Charity, which arises from Truth.
pass_b_english: Wound Truth, and the mystical Body with its members cannot stay in sound union.
Charity — the very bond of that union — is violated the moment it loses the Truth from which it springs.
source_text: Non potest esse sana Unio mystici Corporis ejusque membrorum, cum Veritas laeditur: violatur enim protinus Vinculum Unionis, Charitas, quae è Veritate oritur.
notes: Sana Unio; Vinculum = Charitas from Veritas.
